title: LeanCTX: Compress Agent Context Without Losing What Matters
description:
Introducing LeanCTX, which compresses what your agent reads while remembering what matters. Suddenly, a two-thousand-token file reread can drop to about thirteen tokens, while an eight-hundred-token git status can shrink to around one hundred twenty.

One command to start:
lean-ctx onboard

🔗 Get LeanCTX (free): https://github.com/yvgude/lean-ctx
